purpose: Bindande spatial sanning för omtvistade interiörytor. Modellen beskriver fysisk geometri, inte rumsnamn.

authority.rule: Current implementation is never evidence. A room/function label never creates a wall.

global_rules: Only WALL and GLASS primitives may create visible vertical partitions.
OPEN_AREA and NO_WALL_ZONE forbid inferred partitions.
A semantic room label must never auto-generate geometry.
UNKNOWN or REFERENCE_GAP areas default to no new wall, not a plausible wall.
Gameplay collision or camera helpers must be separate from fidelity geometry.
Every runtime wall in contested areas must carry a canon/source id.
Any wall without a canon/source id in a contested area is a failing build.

source_decisions.decision: Uppehållsrummet is an open area. The wall/closed volume visible in the rejected preview does not exist and must be removed.

geometry.coordinate_system: STALLINNE local metres; N measured from north/club gable

rules: No opaque internal partition may subdivide this open area unless a later Product Owner correction explicitly adds it.
The previously interpreted sluten_volym_v inside this area is revoked.
Furniture may occupy the area but may not imply walls.

revoked_runtime_refs: any wall generated solely from the former closed-volume interpretation inside uppehållsrummet

source_decisions.decision: The rejected preview contains too many walls. The entrance/reception area is substantially open and must not be reconstructed as a set of opaque rooms.
Reception is glazed. Glass enclosure is allowed where source-supported; opaque room-box walls are not a substitute.
The player must be able to walk from the entrance/reception area into the riding hall. The current blocked route is invalid.

rules: Default state is open floor, not opaque partitions.
Current RIDHUSINNE.entrehall.vaggar are revoked as a trusted set and must be re-admitted one segment at a time from evidence.
A functional label such as reception, entrance, changing area or HWC does not itself authorize a wall.
Use transparent/glazed partition where evidence shows reception enclosure.
Do not replace missing glass geometry with opaque walls.

revoked_runtime_refs: RIDHUSINNE.entrehall.vaggar as a blanket source of truth
opaque partitions introduced only because a plan cell was interpreted as a room

acceptance: No wall may block the entrance-to-arena path.
The route must read visually as an open connection, not a narrow service corridor.
Camera helpers may fade geometry but may not compensate for wrong partitions.

uncertain_functions.rule: Preserve only walls independently proven by plan/photo. Do not infer enclosure from the HWC label alone.
Do not turn plan cells into opaque rooms without evidence.

acceptance_tests.test: No runtime WALL intersects stall_uppehall_no_internal_wall except exterior/boundary walls explicitly outside the open interior union.
Every contested-area runtime wall/glass object has canon_id and source_id attributes.
Ridhus main_entrance -> physical_riding_area path is walkable without clipping, teleporting or passing through a fidelity wall.
No opaque ridhus partition exists solely because of a semantic room label.
Web and Roblox consume the same canon ids and topology decisions.

visual_gates: STALL-V1: from parking-side entry, uppehållsrummet reads as one open area.
RIDHUS-V1: entrance/reception view contains no artificial corridor of opaque room boxes.
RIDHUS-V2: player can visually see and physically reach the riding hall from the entrance area.
RIDHUS-V3: reception reads as glass where enclosed, not as a solid-walled room.
